pages.title: Kiang
pages.text: The kiang ($(o)Equus kiang$()) is the largest wild ass, living on the high grasslands of the Tibetan Plateau.$(br2)Its coat is rich chestnut, with white legs, belly, chest and muzzle, a dark stripe down its back and a short, upright mane.$(br2)Kiangs graze at heights of up to 5,300 metres, and in winter they sometimes gather in herds of several hundred.
